description: Individual geolocated wildlife observations for the 10 selected species from observations-794195.csv. Each dot represents one record. Observations and Australian state boundaries are embedded; no scripts or external data files are required. State boundaries: https://github.com/rowanhogan/australian-states. Recorded coordinates may be obscured and observations do not measure animal population size. Click a species colour or name in the legend to filter the map; click it again or Show all species to clear that filter. The state dropdown lists regions with records for the selected species; changing species resets the state filter. The map includes observation dates in 2017–2026. State assignments use recorded coordinates within the embedded boundaries, falling back to explicit state names or abbreviations in the location field. Offshore or unassigned records remain available under Offshore / unspecified. Map callouts label the three states or territories with the highest observation counts under the current filters, anchored at representative positions inside each region. Offshore / unspecified records are excluded from this ranking. Callouts outside the visible map extent are hidden when panning or zooming. Species colours match the ten-species palette in BumpChart.vg.json; species selection is retained; counts use the selected observation years. Uses the 10 most recent available observation years (2017–2026), including partial 2026.
